description: Install data packs for other languages and countries — "fr", "de", "ja", "france", "brazil" — when tdc_find_packs says a locale is missing. Runs `tdcv2 pack add` of the engine this project uses, which downloads the packs from the public TDCv2 pack registry. In a project without a pack store it first runs `tdcv2 init --yes`, which writes tdcv2.config.json and a tdcv2-packs/ folder there (engines before --no-examples also add a few tdcv2-examples/ files).

ids.description: Pack ids: a language ("fr", "pt", "zh-cn") or a country ("france", "brazil", "united_kingdom").

name: tdc_pack_add
title: Install TDCv2 data packs
